entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 120(B)/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a person with clean antecedent and the informant alleges that petitioner alongwith other accused persons are active member of a Cyber crime gang which is involved in alluring general public in the name of agency of Himalaya Company and also providing loans from Bajaj Finance, further as per seizure list huge number of mobile embedded with sim have been recovered.

It is next alleged that huge amount of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.15499 of 2023(2) dt.19-06-2023 money was collected in different account thereafter,
the same was withdrawn and was distributed among the gang members.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was not apprehended from the spot as such nothing was recovered from his conscious.

It is next submitted that from perusal of FIR itself it would manifest that his name transpired in the confessional statement of apprehended co-accused,
it is further submitted that similarly situated co-accused persons have been granted the privilege of Arun Noniya vs The State Of Bihar on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35413902/
1 anticipatory bail by order dated 16.05.2023 in Cr. Misc No. 7971 of 2023, order dated 19.05.2023 in Cr. Misc. No. 14529 of 2023, order dated 25.05.2023 in Cr. Misc. No. 14987 of 2023 and order dated 16.05.2023 in Cr. Misc. No. 2455 of 2023.

entities.text: Cr. Misc No. 7971 of 2023, order dated 19.05.2023 in Cr. Misc. No. 14529 of 2023, order dated 25.05.2023 in Cr. Misc. No. 14987 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner next submits that the petitioner is a person with clean antecedent and on parity also seeks anticipatory bail.
Learned A.P.P. for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner above-named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned trial court within a period of six weeks from today, be released on Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.15499 of 2023(2)
dt.19-06-2023 anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Sheikhopur Sarai P.S. Case No. 136 of 2022 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
One of the bailor of the petitioner shall be his father Chamaru Noniya @ Shankar Noniya.
(Satyavrat Verma, J) Adnan/-
